title: the-proof-record-persists-so-runs-can-be-compared
owner: CC owns the record format, the door onto it, and the proofs. Adoption by each of the other surfaces named in build_inspector's edge (m) belongs to that component's own owner (Law 6) and is follow-on work, not this ticket's to take.
intention: Check runs leave a comparable record, so two runs can be set against each other and the corpus can answer questions no single run can: which checks have never redded, and which check ran last time and did not run this time. A SHARED record format with build_inspector as first tenant, behind a door of its own rather than five writers appending directly. GREEN IS RECORDED, not only failures — a record of failures cannot distinguish a green from an absence, which is the entire disease.
why:
THIS CASHES A FINDING ALREADY ON FILE, and citing it rather than rediscovering it is the point (Law 1). build_inspector's charter has carried filed edge (m) since 2026-08-13: 'THE PROOF RECORD IS BUILT AND THROWN AWAY. It is computed per run and never persisted, so nothing compares this run's record against the last one — which means a sieve that silently STOPS RUNNING shortens the list and NOBODY IS TOLD.' Akien's own note on that edge was 'SAME PATTERN EVERYWHERE': the derivation gate, the ruling intake, the emit chokepoint, the tester and `cairn determinism` all report only their failures. The edge says it belongs to whichever component builds the comparison first. This is that.

THE LIVED SYMPTOM, and it is the cheapest one to state: a sieve stops running. Nothing fails. The run is green, shorter by one line that nobody counts, and the component it was guarding is now unguarded — silently, indefinitely, and with a green build as evidence that all is well. The same shape covers a check that has been green for two hundred runs and has never once redded: it is either guarding something genuinely stable or it is vacuous, and today there is no way to ask.

WHY IT IS THE SUBSTRATE OF THE CORROSION PROGRAM. 'A check that has never redded' is the cheapest corrosion prior available — fully deterministic, no LLM, and it turns 'review the corpus periodically' into 'review the checks that have never fired', which is small and targeted (Law 1: spend the resolver on the novel). It is also unanswerable while every surface throws its record away. Nothing else in the program can be built on sand.
traces_to: cairn/cairn/machines/build_inspector/intention+why.json filed edge (m), 2026-08-13, and Akien's ruling on it: 'SAME PATTERN EVERYWHERE'
Ruling 2026-08-14-corrosion-is-drift-with-no-ruling-behind-it — this is the substrate the ranked set is computed from
Law 3 — nothing is known until measured; 'this check is sound' is unmeasured while its history is discarded
Law 7 — errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces and permanent in records of truth; a record that keeps only failures is not a record of truth about what ran
Law 1 — a question answered once should become structure; 'did this check run last time?' is currently re-derived by a human reading two runs side by side, when it can be derived at all

falsifier.proves_green: PROVE GATE — tester teeth: two runs of the same surface produce comparable records; a check present in run 1 and ABSENT in run 2 surfaces as a finding (the silent-stop tooth, edge (m)'s own case, which a hollow build would omit); a check green in both runs is queryable as never-redded; a record containing only failures FAILS the format check, since green must be recorded to distinguish it from absence; the query answers over MORE THAN ONE surface. BUILD GATE — build_inspector at the PROVEME crossing, which is self-referential in a useful way: the component whose edge this cashes is the gate it crosses. DURABILITY GATE — committed to both repos. KICKS BACK ON — red proof routes to build at the point of creation (CP2).
falsifier.proves_red: RED if: (1) records are written and nothing ever compares two runs — accumulation without a question, which is the current defect using more disk; (2) a check that silently stops running does not surface; (3) the record cannot answer 'which checks have never redded'; (4) it is built as build_inspector's private log when five surfaces share the silence; (5) the record captures only failures.
falsifier.horizon: FIRST of the corrosion instruments and deliberately so — the LLM review pass cannot be specified at all until the ranked set it fires on exists, and `an-agreement-check-proves-both-halves-can-red` can be built before this but its result cannot be trusted over time until this lands. Behind the chart floor build order Akien set the same day (orient, then constrain, then survey).

questions.a: PERSISTENCE IS THE SUBSTRATE, COMPARISON IS THE GOAL. A persisted record nothing compares is a bigger version of the current defect: data accumulating while the question goes unasked. This is why the ticket is not done when records land on disk, and why persistence is not split off as a child — a child that can pass while embodying the parent's failure is a decomposition that makes the work worse.

A RECORD OF FAILURES CANNOT SUPPORT ANY OF THIS. Green must be recorded, because the disease is the inability to tell a green from an absence. Same shape as the answer the monitoring field converged on independently: NO DATA is a third state, configured separately, never a variant of pass or fail.

THE MANAGER SMELL IS REAL AND THE DEFENCE HAS TO BE SPECIFIC. A corpus-wide record of every check run is exactly the central collection CC builds the moment something exists in plural, and the honest test is who needs to see them ALL. The answer here is a named singular consumer — the corrosion review — and a question that genuinely spans components: 'has this check ever redded' cannot be computed per component.

SCOPE DECISION MADE VISIBLE RATHER THAN DEFAULTED: a shared format with build_inspector as first tenant, not one component's private log. Five private logs cannot answer the corpus-spanning question, which is the only reason the record exists.

how: Build persistent check-run records so two runs can be compared: which checks changed, which went red/green, which were added/removed. The record format carries the run's findings in a shape that supports diff.

watchme.as_cast_verbatim: PROBE at cairn/machines/corrosion/probes/the_comparison_is_read.py — fires when 20+ runs of records have accumulated and no comparison has ever produced a finding that reached a human or a ticket; clears when at least one comparison finding has been acted on.
watchme.trigger: records have accumulated over 20 or more runs and no comparison has ever produced a finding that reached a human or a ticket — this ticket's own falsifier clause (1) turned into a standing watch, because it is the failure most likely to happen quietly and to look like success on disk
watchme.enough: cleared when at least one comparison finding has been acted on — a check found silently stopped, or a never-redded check investigated and either fixed or confirmed sound. An existence claim: one acted-on finding proves the loop closes, whereas a count of records proves only that writing works
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the run count, comparisons performed, findings produced, and their dispositions — all four, since findings-produced without dispositions is the same silence one level up
watchme.consumer: CC as owner; Akien if the answer is that nothing reads it, because that makes the substrate ticket of the corrosion program a hole and the sequencing is his

intent_berth: none, because this node entered at TICKET, a legal entry point (decisions/2026-08-02-three-entry-points-and-structural-refiled). The entry evidence is on disk and predates the conversation: build_inspector's filed edge (m).
chart_claim: none, because no chart chain was run — the finding is a direct read of an already-filed edge plus the ruling recorded the same day. BUILDME's entry gate is where this is answered or the chain is run.
dependencies: MEASURED, not assumed: build_inspector already computes a full proof record per run (one line per sieve) — the record EXISTS and is discarded, so this ticket is persistence plus a door plus a query, not a new instrument.

OPEN AT CAST, for the build: WHERE THE RECORDS BERTH. They are runtime state, so ~/.cairn/ under the holder — but that makes them unshareable, and a never-redded ranking computed on one laptop is a measurement nobody else can reproduce.

OPEN AT CAST: RETENTION. A per-run record for every check across five surfaces grows without bound and has not been sized. The in-house precedent to compose is logger_for_bash's write-fired amortized retention — a pattern, not a number to copy.
filed_edges: THE OTHER FOUR SURFACES NAMED IN EDGE (m) — the derivation gate, ruling intake, emit chokepoint, tester and `cairn determinism` — each need their own crossing under their own owner to adopt the format. This ticket proves with one tenant, which means 'the query answers over more than one surface' is proved against a fixture rather than against five live adopters. That is a real limit of the proof and is stated rather than hidden.

NOTHING FIRES THE COMPARISON. The record makes the question answerable; it does not make anyone ask. The watch above is the interim answer, and the durable one is an event rather than a poll — a comparison fired by the run that writes the record, which is the shape this system prefers everywhere and is not designed here.
